name: Wrenn
aliases: the sprout that used to be Wrenn
description: Wrenn is a dryad planeswalker with a fire in her chest who travels the planes bonded to a series of trees.

summary.text: Wrenn is a dryad planeswalker with a fire in her chest who travels the planes bonded to a series of trees.

bio.text: Fire devoured her people's trees until she pulled it into herself, her spark ignited, and she merged with a tree and learned to control the fire.
On Innistrad she uprooted herself from her long-time partner Six, met Teferi, and bonded with the sapling Seven.
She then helped guard Teferi and fought beside Nissa against the Phyrexians.
Chandra coached her on controlling her fire, and the two went to New Phyrexia, where Phyrexian Nissa tore Seven apart and took Wrenn prisoner.
Unable to walk, she was carried by Chandra to the Invasion Tree, where she melded with it despite its rejection, and found a sapling she named Eight.
She found Teferi out of time and grew a portal that brought Zhalfir to New Phyrexia at the cost of herself and Eight, after which Teferi planted an acorn in her memory.

status.text: She burned away as an ashen statue with an acorn hidden in the ash, and later regrew as a fast-growing sprout on a hill above the village on Zhalfir.

timeline.summary: Wrenn and Six arrive in the Kessig forest near where they first met.
timeline.quote: put their massive foot down on the soil of Innistrad, deep within the Kessig forest

timeline.summary: Wrenn uproots herself from Six, who becomes an oak, ending their partnership.
timeline.quote: she uprooted herself and was no longer joined with Six

timeline.summary: Wrenn promises to return someday to find Six and offer his acorns the same choice.
timeline.quote: I will walk these woods again, and I will find you, old friend

timeline.summary: Wrenn wanders the forest following treesong toward a possible new partner.
timeline.quote: following the whisper of treesong that told her there was a viable partner growing here

timeline.summary: Teferi, drifting away from the cathars, finds a pale woman speaking to an oak.
timeline.quote: paused when he saw the figure standing in the shadow of one of the great oaks

timeline.summary: Wrenn explains a fire devoured her people's trees until she pulled it into herself, where it still burns.
timeline.quote: It devoured the trees of my people, until I found a way to pull it into myself.

timeline.summary: Hearing the cathars, Wrenn suspects Teferi lured her and summons fire.
timeline.quote: So you were a lure to call and catch me, then?

timeline.summary: Teferi offers Wrenn his arm and they walk deeper into the forest to avoid the cathars.
timeline.quote: Then we walk.

timeline.summary: Teferi senses an unseen presence following them.
timeline.quote: We're being followed,

timeline.summary: Teferi's blue magic reveals a twisted humanoid, which he banishes in a burst of necrotic energy.
timeline.quote: finally vanished in a burst of terrible, necrotic energy

timeline.summary: The path behind them has become a tangle of identical branching paths crackling with time magic.
timeline.quote: The distinctive crackle of time magic hung over it all.

timeline.summary: Wrenn laments that the tree that called her is gone.
timeline.quote: The tree that called me is gone.

timeline.summary: They exchange names, and Wrenn says she has heard of Teferi's legend.
timeline.quote: They call me Wrenn.

timeline.summary: Wrenn says she will trust Teferi for now, admitting she will die without a tree.
timeline.quote: I will trust you for now.

timeline.summary: After hours of walking, Wrenn points out they are looping back toward where they began.
timeline.quote: We've made a big loop.

timeline.summary: Wrenn lends her natural magic so Teferi can hold his tangled spell.
timeline.quote: She hummed, a single clear, carrying note, and the natural magic of the wood swirled around him

timeline.summary: Teferi unmakes the tangled spell by following Wrenn's advice and restores the path.
timeline.quote: Bit by bit, he straightened and unbent the cogs, repairing the spell's original intent

timeline.summary: Wrenn walks to an oak and dives into it, finding the sapling that sang to her.
timeline.quote: Wrenn was walking, step by unsteady step, toward that tree.

timeline.summary: The tree unfolds into a slumbering treefolk with Wrenn joined to its chest.
timeline.quote: it unfolded into the model of a man, a slumbering treefolk in the process of waking

timeline.summary: Wrenn tells Teferi that Seven is grateful because his bent time ripened the sapling.
timeline.quote: Seven says they are grateful for what you've done

timeline.summary: Wrenn leaves with Seven to show it lands outside Innistrad.
timeline.quote: I have promised Seven lands outside of Innistrad, and I must keep my word.

timeline.summary: Teferi confesses to Wrenn how he took Zhalfir away from Urza's war and calls himself the true heir to Urza's mantle.
timeline.quote: Then I siphoned energy from the closed portal to fuel a spell spiriting Zhalfir away from space and time itself.

timeline.summary: Wrenn tells Teferi she is not here to absolve him.
timeline.quote: I am not here to provide you absolution, mage.

timeline.summary: Wrenn tells Elspeth she lives two melodies, one in light and one in shadow, and Elspeth angrily denies it.
timeline.quote: It is as if you live two separate lives. One in light, one in shadow.

timeline.summary: Wrenn senses visitors, and Elspeth confronts two figures glowing green in the rain.
timeline.quote: Are you Elspeth?

timeline.summary: A Phyrexian skyship overpowers the watchtowers, and Elspeth orders Wrenn and Nissa to protect Teferi.
timeline.quote: Wrenn and Nissa, protect Teferi at all costs.

timeline.summary: At night Nissa, Wrenn and construct guardians hold the tower hall against Phyrexians who cross the threshold.
timeline.quote: Over two dozen Phyrexians had met with similar fates in the tower hall

timeline.summary: A pillar of light scorches the sky and steam covers the vale, leaving Elspeth and Jodah's fate unknown.
timeline.quote: Suddenly, a pillar of light scorched the sky outside the tower like a sun ascending

timeline.summary: Nissa commands the mechanical soldiers to meet the army, but nature spirits refuse her call and leylines are tangled.
timeline.quote: They recoiled at her presence.

timeline.summary: The constructs and Phyrexians clash, and the Phyrexians fight with unusual tactics, pinning the machines.
timeline.quote: The armies collided with sharp staccato thunderclaps.

timeline.summary: Nissa lends Wrenn and Seven her strength and Seven hurls her at the flying Phyrexian general, whom she stabs repeatedly with a seed-bearing sword.
timeline.quote: With each stab, she'd implanted a seed within the Phyrexian

timeline.summary: Nissa kills the crippled Phyrexian general with vines, after Wrenn urges her to stop, deciding she must be decisive when the time comes.
timeline.quote: The vines obeyed her command.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Wrenn find Nahiri and Jace in the workshop with the wrecked Temporal Anchor, whose powerstone has imploded.
timeline.quote: The powerstone imploded and overloaded the anchor,

timeline.summary: Wrenn warns them not to disturb the capsule where Teferi is fading across time; Kaya says she can get the sylex to work.
timeline.quote: Teferi's chord is still tethered to this device,

timeline.summary: The planeswalkers wait in Liliana's safe house on Dominaria for two weeks of word from the strike team.
timeline.quote: For two weeks they'll wait here in one of Liliana's cabins on Dominaria.

timeline.summary: Chandra coaches Wrenn on controlling her inner fire and recalls Jaya's teachings and Ajani's killing of Jaya.
timeline.quote: Jaya's dead, Ajani killed her

timeline.summary: Tyvar's arrival heralds the return of survivors from New Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: the brash war-horn boom of Tyvar's arrival falls like an axe between them

timeline.summary: Wrenn joins Chandra, saying the World Tree is alive and that she can reach Teferi with Chandra's fire and the World Tree's power.
timeline.quote: The others were wrong—that tree is alive.

timeline.summary: Chandra, Wrenn and Seven leave to head for New Phyrexia while unseen watchers observe them.
timeline.quote: Let's head out.

timeline.summary: Unseen watchers declare they are there to witness the beginning of the end.
timeline.quote: We are here to witness the beginning of the end.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Wrenn arrive on New Phyrexia and find a bright landscape dominated by a vast Invasion Tree.
timeline.quote: Chandra can't comprehend how tall the Invasion Tree is.

timeline.summary: They find Mirran survivors under Koth and Melira, and Chandra pitches that Wrenn will bond with the tree to guide it.
timeline.quote: We'll head for the tree. Once we're there, I'll attach myself to him, and try to guide him,

timeline.summary: Koth says Karn was taken near the tree and agrees to try to take control of the tree and rescue him.
timeline.quote: We may as well try to gain control of the tree and rescue him at the same time.

timeline.summary: They plan to have Koth launch Chandra and Wrenn across a chasm while the Mirrans distract Norn.
timeline.quote: The rest of the Mirrans will provide a tantalizing distraction for the so-called Mother of Machines.

timeline.summary: Koth launches Chandra and Wrenn through the air, and bladed bats attack.
timeline.quote: Koth drives his fist into the earth.

timeline.summary: Chandra lands hard on the tree and Wrenn prepares to bond while centurions form around them.
timeline.quote: Plates along the tree shift and reform.

timeline.summary: Centurions speak with one woman's voice and spears pin Chandra to the tree while Phyrexian Nissa attacks Wrenn.
timeline.quote: Green magic crackles around her metallic body, her four arms all acting as conduits.

timeline.summary: Nissa tears Seven apart and drops Wrenn, saying she no longer feels pain.
timeline.quote: I no longer feel any pain.

timeline.summary: Nissa has copper branches seize Wrenn, whom she calls a fine guardian for Realmbreaker.
timeline.quote: You will make a fine guardian for Realmbreaker,

timeline.summary: Wrenn signals Chandra as flames glow within her, unnoticed by Norn.
timeline.quote: Flames flicker within her pale body.

timeline.summary: Chandra drives her fiery fist into the branch, blowing the platform apart and flinging herself and Nissa away while Wrenn clings to the tree.
timeline.quote: Chandra ducks below Nissa's slicing arm and drives her fiery fist into the branch itself.

timeline.summary: Koth, Wrenn and Chandra are brought as prisoners, and Elspeth recognizes Nissa as a Phyrexian centurion delivering them.
timeline.quote: "Behold the traitors," speaks one of the centurions

timeline.summary: Time stops; Serra appears among the prisoners and reveals the choice is whether Elspeth keeps Nissa occupied long enough for Wrenn to reach the tree.
timeline.quote: It's to keep Nissa occupied long enough for Wrenn to reach the tree.

timeline.summary: Wrenn, who can no longer walk, asks Chandra to carry her toward the Invasion Tree.
timeline.quote: She scoops Wrenn up.

timeline.summary: Nissa pursues the fleeing group, flinging bodies at them and threatening to kill Chandra unless she drops Wrenn.
timeline.quote: "Drop the dryad and there's still hope for you, Chandra.

timeline.summary: Elspeth dodges Norn's blade storm with a sharp turn and unleashes a ray of light, then flies toward the tree to ensure Wrenn and Chandra make it.
timeline.quote: With all her problems concentrated in one place, Elspeth at last unleashes a ray of light.

timeline.summary: Carried by Chandra toward the Invasion Tree, Wrenn fears she cannot do what everyone relies on her to do, as the tree does not answer her.
timeline.quote: That is what truly frightens Wrenn: the possibility that she may not be able to do what everyone is relying upon her to do.

timeline.summary: Koth shields the group from a rain of needles as Chandra, struggling, carries Wrenn.
timeline.quote: Koth levitates the metal beneath their feet to a shield over their heads.

timeline.summary: Nissa's barbed vine goes through Melira's stomach and attacks Chandra and Wrenn.
timeline.quote: the other end of the tendril's gone clean through Melira's stomach.

timeline.summary: Nissa catches Chandra by the ankle and hoists her up; Wrenn falls and the Mirrans pass her hand to hand toward the tree.
timeline.quote: Nissa lifting her by the ankle with a long and brassy root.

timeline.summary: Nissa strangles Chandra with vines while Melira helps Wrenn up to the observation platform.
timeline.quote: Vines wrap about Chandra's throat.

timeline.summary: Melira places Wrenn against the tree and lends her strength before collapsing against it.
timeline.quote: magic ebbs from Melira's hand, glowing a faint white.

timeline.summary: Wrenn melds into Realmbreaker, who rejects her; oil floods her senses and she begins to sing in defiance.
timeline.quote: Wrenn begins to sing.

timeline.summary: Wrenn's fire flares and burns Realmbreaker's voices and herself.
timeline.quote: A flare within her belly, the smell of burning oak.

timeline.summary: Chandra recalls their talk on Dominaria and pulls Wrenn's fire into herself so Wrenn can shape it.
timeline.quote: Fire's going to burn, no matter what you do, but you can shape it if you try.

timeline.summary: In a vision, Wrenn sings to find a lonely sapling in a lake of black oil and shields him with flaming trees.
timeline.quote: Flaming trees grow to the size of mountains

timeline.summary: Eight grows tall, and Wrenn names him Eight and resolves to bring him to Teferi.
timeline.quote: Hello, Eight , she says. Let's introduce you to Teferi.

timeline.summary: Wrenn and Eight tear holes across planes and see the Phyrexian invasion everywhere.
timeline.quote: Fires churning in his belly, Eight reaches for new planes.

timeline.summary: Wrenn and Eight get lost deliberately, tracing Teferi's magic to a hidden place out of time and finding him at a gathering of peaceful people.
timeline.quote: Among them—standing at the queen's side—is Teferi.

timeline.summary: Wrenn calls to Teferi, who vouches for her to the queen and asks how he can help.
timeline.quote: "She's a friend of mine."

timeline.summary: Wrenn asks Teferi to come to New Phyrexia to help the losing fight.
timeline.quote: "We need you on New Phyrexia.

timeline.summary: Wrenn realizes she can push planes together to bring Zhalfir into New Phyrexia, at the cost of herself and Eight, and asks Teferi to bring his friends.
timeline.quote: "Wait," she says. "Don't come alone. Bring your friends."

timeline.summary: Wrenn and Teferi say a farewell as thousands answer his call.
timeline.quote: "Whatever remains of me will always remember my friend, Wrenn,"

timeline.summary: Wrenn grows a massive portal as Elspeth is flung through the gate by a war engine, and the Phyrexian army pours through into Zhalfir's peaceful land.
timeline.quote: The monstrosity flings the angel through the gate

timeline.summary: Teferi plants an acorn on a grassy hill as a tribute to Wrenn and speaks to the mound.
timeline.quote: He lays the acorn in the little clearing he has made, then fills it in.

timeline.summary: Teferi finds an acorn hidden in the ashen remains of Wrenn and takes it.
timeline.quote: an acorn hidden within the ash.

timeline.summary: Nissa tries to meditate beside the sprout of Wrenn but her connection to the Multiverse is smothered by the voices of those who touched her mind, and she collapses in pain.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: She screams for real.

timeline.summary: A malevolent force tries to burn Wrenn's forest, and she absorbs the inferno into her own body.
timeline.quote: Wrenn absorbed the inferno into her own body.

timeline.summary: Nearly incinerated, Wrenn's planeswalker Spark ignites.
timeline.quote: she was nearly incinerated and her Planeswalker Spark ignited.

timeline.summary: Barely alive on a strange plane, Wrenn merges with a nearby tree, and together they discover they can control the fire.
timeline.quote: she merged with a nearby tree in a last act of desperation.

relations.note: Chandra coaches Wrenn on controlling her fire
relations.quote: feeling like it's the thing a mentor should do

relations.note: she destroys Seven and traps Wrenn
relations.quote: she tears Seven limb from limb

relations.note: Melira carries Wrenn and lends her strength
relations.quote: "But I can help you with this, at least a little."

relations.note: Realmbreaker insists she does not belong
Teferi plants an acorn for his friend
relations.quote: With the acorn in hand, he thought of his friend

relations.note: Nissa feels kinship with the sprout of Wrenn
relations.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
relations.quote: she feels a unique kinship with the only other Planeswalker who bound herself to the Invasion Tree.

pages_say.description: A dryad planeswalker with a heart of fire who travels the Planes bonded to a series of trees and who parts from Six to find a new partner on Innistrad.
A dryad planeswalker, with a fire in her chest, whom Teferi recruited for her honest wisdom.
A dryad planeswalker who senses two melodies in Elspeth.
A dryad planeswalker who guards Teferi and fights beside Nissa.
A dryad whose songs Teferi thinks of.
A planeswalker who would call the path a song.
A dryad planeswalker with a fire within her whom Chandra tutors, and who volunteers to help her reach Teferi and the World Tree.
A dryad planeswalker who plans to bond with the Invasion Tree and guide it, and is seized by Nissa.
A dryad planeswalker torn from her tree and brought before Norn, whom Elspeth chooses to help reach the Invasion Tree.
A dryad planeswalker who can no longer walk and needs to reach the Invasion Tree to find Teferi.
A dryad planeswalker who grafts herself onto the Invasion Tree, finds the sapling Eight, and opens a portal that brings Teferi and Zhalfir's army to New Phyrexia at great cost to herself.
A dryad planeswalker who saved the Multiverse by swapping New Phyrexia and Zhalfir; Teferi plants an acorn in her memory.
A dryad whose burned remains stand as an ashen statue on the tree, with an acorn hidden in the ash.
A dryad now regrown as a fast-growing sprout on a hill above the village, nurtured by Zhalfir's suns.
Someone Chandra met who made her lose one of her newest friends.
A tree-coaxing friend of Chandra's, contrasted with her blunt methods.
A planeswalker who was once a dryad protecting a vast forest, now merged with a tree and seeking to rid herself of the fire she absorbed.
